question: How many columns are there in a sheet of Excel 2010?
solution:
The correct answer is __**16384**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Microsoft Excel **Starter **2010 **is **a spreadsheet program **designed for **everyday tasks **such as **setting up a budget**, **maintaining an address list**, or **keeping track **of a **list of to-do items**.
 
• **Excel Starter **is part of **Microsoft Office Starter 2010**.
 
• **MS Excel **is **a commercial spreadsheet application **that is **produced **and distributed by **Microsoft for Microsoft Windows **and **Mac OS operating systems**.
 
• It features the **ability to perform basic calculations**, **use graphing tools**, **create pivot tables **and **create macros**, among other **useful features**.
 
• For **MS Excel 2010**, **Row numbers **range from **1 to 1048576**; in **total 1048576 rows **and **Columns range **from **A to XFD**; in **total 16384 columns**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Microsoft Office **is a **suite **of **applications designed **to help with **productivity and completing common tasks **on a **computer.**
 
• You can **create **and **edit documents **containing **text and images**, **work **with **data **in **spreadsheets **and **databases**, and **create presentations and posters**.
 
• **The three major Microsoft Office **pieces include the **word processor (Word), **the **spreadsheet (Excel), **and the **visual presentation tool (PowerPoint).**
